name: Syncbar
author: Jon
description: Watch Syncthing from the Omarchy bar: folder sync state, how far behind you are, and whether any peer is actually connected.

barWidget.description: Syncthing folder state, sync progress and peer connectivity.

schema.label: Show state on the bar
schema.description: Off leaves just the icon, coloured by state.

schema.label: Warn when no peer is connected
schema.description: Folders can be perfectly in sync locally with nothing to sync to. On by default because that state looks healthy and is not.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: Syncthing's API is local and answers in milliseconds, so this can be brisk.
